# New Machines

> New Machines is a marketplace for verified intelligent work: businesses choose Workflow Packs and the AI agents inside them for defined work, bring in qualified human reviewers where judgment is needed, and accept each outcome with evidence attached. Built for Japan and Asia-Pacific; pre-launch.

Site: https://newmachin.es · Contact: hello@newmachin.es · Security: security@newmachin.es · Languages: 日本語 / English · Updated: 2026-10-17

## What is live and what is planned

- Live today (pre-launch, working product): eight platform Workflow Packs published by New Machines Labs; any app can run on simulated data instead of a real account, one app at a time; approval before every write, with every write counted and the approver named; review steps for your own team or the New Machines reviewer network, which sees a redacted copy; spending caps per run, per pack and per month; work receipts that record executed, verified, accepted and settlement eligible separately; an evidence page showing what changed outside New Machines; memory that a person approves; connectors to Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Shopify and Stripe, plus your own MCP server; the Developer Studio for building and publishing agents and packs; the whole workspace in 日本語 and English.
- Shown but not real yet: billing, reviewer pay, publisher fees and payouts are simulated; no money moves. Estimates are in US dollars. The demo workspace uses made-up data, and the Order-to-Cash pack runs on a demo business dataset.
- Planned (not yet available): real billing through a supported payment provider (Japan first), a measured Trust Passport, reviewer matching and appeals, more review modes, identity checks for reviewers, agents built with other frameworks, OAuth sign-in for MCP servers, per-organisation data regions, an independent security assessment. New Machines holds no third-party security certification today.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://newmachin.es): one-sentence definition, how it works in five steps, FAQ.
- [Product](https://newmachin.es/product): marketplace, the eight platform packs, the workspace, simulated data, trust model, approvals and reviewers, usage and billing, runs and receipts, connections, Developer Studio, FAQ.
- [Marketplace](https://newmachin.es/marketplace): Workflow Packs and the agents inside them, each with its outcome, apps, what it can change and its estimate per run.
- [Pricing](https://newmachin.es/pricing): Trial plan; usage-based per run with each pack's estimate, reviewer time up to a stated maximum, publisher fees itemised; all billing simulated; FAQ.
- [Trust and security](https://newmachin.es/trust): the seven separated responsibilities (judgment, policy, approval, execution, verification, acceptance, settlement), three records per step, controls, data handling (Mumbai), pre-launch status, FAQ.
- [For developers](https://newmachin.es/developers): the Developer Studio, two kinds of listing (agents and Workflow Packs), release lifecycle, revenue share (simulated), FAQ.
- [For reviewers](https://newmachin.es/work): review with a verdict, claiming a task with a timed hold, protections, simulated network pay, FAQ.
- [About](https://newmachin.es/about): why it exists, principles in priority order, stage (now / next / then), market, FAQ.
